'''Armed & Operational''' was Players Committee '''Virtual Set 14''' in the pre&ndash;September 2009 numbered Virtual program. Overview and confidence notes: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Era map: [[History of the Players Committee]]. Icon shorthand used on these sheets: [[Virtual card icons]].

== Cover pack / set symbol ==

Players Committee printed Virtual set covers with pack mockups and set marks for the later numbered Virtual sheets (same visual family as the Dec 2006 Remaster / Re-edit covers for earlier sets). Cover pack art and circular set symbol from the same printable sheet (no separate Dec 2006 Remaster of an earlier slip). IA Resources/VirtualCards14.pdf has only 2021 301 redirects &mdash; no application/pdf binary; CDN legacyblocks used.

Narrative tip (Bill/Chief): PC remade Virtual cards to look nicer for this cover-pack wave &mdash; framing matches [[Virtual Set 1 (Original)]] / [[Virtual Set 16 (Original)]] treatment. Do not invent symbol meanings beyond the PDF ICON KEY / cover (see [[Virtual card icons]]).

== Provenance ==

Primary cover PDF used for pack and set symbol on this hub:

* CDN day-to-day: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards14.pdf VirtualCards14.pdf]
* Wayback Resources/VirtualCards14.pdf: no application/pdf binary recovered (see hunt notes on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]] / Alpha1 VC Original packs report)

After the 2009 Block reorganization these cards were regrouped into [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]] / Legacy packaging; framing, errata, and legality can differ. Do not invent card text on this stub.

See also: [[Virtual Set 1 (Original)]] (Legacy sheet pattern), [[Virtual Set 16 (Original)]], [[Defensive Shields]], [[Virtual Shields]], [[Virtual card icons]], [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].
